report.title: Year and month navigation in calendar page
report.body: ### Check before submitting - [x] I searched existing issues and did not find a duplicate ### What problem would this solve? I fill Memos with data scattered over the years. It's hard to switch between years and months using the built-in switch. ### What would you like to happen? For the convenience of filling in the calendar display, it will be good to arrange the output of years and months in a row - there is enough empty space for easy navigation. These may be the years for which records exist. And use labels (dots) for months which contain entries. ### Additional context _No response_

plan.reported_actual: Switching between years and months in the calendar is hard when memos are scattered over many years.
